messages:
sara_cs: Heads up — HalcyonPay (mid-market payments) asked to onboard a compact NER model into Private (VPC) with HSM for POS chargeback tagging. They want low p95 latency (<120ms) and strict PCI scoping. Renewal shows churn risk unless we accelerate.
priya_sols: Do we have their dataset? any PHI/PCI fields present?
sara_cs: They uploaded a redacted 10k transactions set to the customer binder (s3://halcyonpay-binder/redacted-10k). They still have tokenized card data and customer IDs in the payload that need KMS/HSM protection. Main asks: F1 >= 0.87, FP rate <1%, RAM footprint <8GB, private deploy only. Wants canary in us-west1 first.
marco_ml: We can try a quantized 3B (4-bit) variant. I need to run the compatibility pipeline — if PCI tokens present, Private+HSM is mandatory. I'll run a quick eval tonight.
elena_security: Halcyon is PCI-compliant but requires: (1) no external telemetry, (2) FIPS KMS or equivalent HSM integration, (3) audit logs retained 12 months. Also require redaction validation step in the eval.
jordan_pm: FYI renewal alert — Halcyon's contract renewal window opens in 60 days. Usage plateauing; if onboarding drags, risk of them switching. Need to prioritize onboarding as a retention play.
priya_sols: I'll coordinate enablement. Proposed workshop Wed 9am PT. Marco, are you available for a 30m tech handoff?
marco_ml: Yes. Also kicking off evals now. I will post the first snapshot here. Sample eval config I'm using:
```yaml
pipeline: ner_eval
model: quantized-3b-4bit
dataset: s3://halcyonpay-binder/redacted-10k.jsonl
metrics:
  - f1
  - fp_rate
thresholds:
  f1: 0.87
  fp_rate: 0.01
resources:
  mem_limit: 8GB
  deploy_mode: private
```
sara_cs: Customer specifically asked for a dry-run canary in us-west1 only. I've shared the per-region access list to their infra contact.
deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved — halcyonpay-1775556789, region: us-west1, start: 2026-03-29T16:00Z, duration: 72h. Assigned: @marco_ml. Link: https://console.redwood/canaries/halcyonpay-1775556789
marco_ml: Thanks — I'll do compatibility + eval and post results here. If the quantized model misses targets, propose fallback: smaller NER encoder + server-side reranker or a tuned 7B with aggressive quant.
elena_security: Also need an IP allowlist from Halcyon infra, signed DPA, and confirmation that no PII leaves their VPC. Sara, can you collect and upload?
sara_cs: On it — collecting IP ranges and DPA signatures. Uploaded the transaction schema to the binder as well. Any blockers?
priya_sols: No blockers from enablement side. We'll do pre-workshop checklist and share slides.
jordan_pm: Adding renewal owner to thread: @lina_account_exec — can you join the Wed enablement and push for temporary extension if we need runway?
lina_account_exec: Joining — I can ask for a 30-day preliminary extension contingent on meeting the canary milestone.
marco_ml: I'll post an initial eval snapshot by EOD tomorrow.
sara_cs: Great, thanks everyone :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: canary halcyonpay-1775556789 starting 2026-03-29T16:00Z. Check status: https://console.redwood/canaries/halcyonpay-1775556789
